brief: Follow-up to the outbound-scrub work (SEC-3). jarvis/v2/diff_review.py _clean makes a model-written field (the review summary and each finding's why and file) safe to show: it applies the credential scrub (redact.scrub_text) and removes invisible characters. A provider key with a zero-width or bidi character inside it (U+200B, U+2060, U+202E, U+FEFF placed inside each provider key shape) is not redacted. Make the cleaned text redact such keys. Text without invisible characters behaves exactly as before.
